claim: Try it with sample data loads three realistic catch records in one action.
sandbox: Fresh browser context opens the landing page and enters /demo.

claim: Demo changes do not change a real log, and Start for real discards the sample.
sandbox: Fresh context creates a real record, changes/reset demo data, then returns to the real log.

claim: Catch records stay in this browser across a reload.
sandbox: Fresh context saves a complete catch, reloads, and checks the rendered record.

claim: Photo details are read only after you choose Read photo details, with manual fallback.
sandbox: Fresh context selects a PNG, invokes the explicit action, observes manual fallback, and records request origins.

claim: Each catch can save exact, approximate, or removed coordinates.
where: capture form, How to make a useful catch record, Privacy
sandbox: Fresh context saves rounded approximate coordinates, then changes the same catch to removed.

claim: You can edit a catch, remove it, and undo the removal.
sandbox: Demo records are edited, removed through the confirmation dialog, and restored with Undo.

claim: Export CSV creates one row for each catch.
sandbox: Demo data is exported and the downloaded CSV header plus three record rows are checked.

claim: Back up JSON exports and imports a portable catch log.
sandbox: Demo data is exported as JSON, then a shipped Catch Photo Log backup is imported.

claim: Print / save PDF sends a populated catch log to the browser print action.
sandbox: Demo data is loaded and the browser print integration is invoked from the visible control.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: A new browser context opens /demo, waits for the worker, reloads, goes offline, and opens /demo again.

claim: The free catch-log flow needs no account, payment, analytics, or third-party request.
sandbox: A fresh context records a catch while all requests are captured and account/payment controls are absent.

claim: Night chart choice stays selected after a reload.
sandbox: A fresh context selects Night, reloads, and observes the dark document theme.
